subject: camera app T4: the camera's open() flag numbers, the storage fix and the first app capture

root_cause.summary: storage_platform.h used the generic Linux O_DIRECTORY (0200000) and O_NOFOLLOW (0400000); on the camera O_DIRECTORY is 040000 and the generic O_DIRECTORY bit is O_DIRECT, which the FUSE exfat card rejects with EINVAL

how_identified.O_DIRECTORY: a regular file opened with the bit gives ENOTDIR (20)
how_identified.O_NOFOLLOW: a symbolic link opened with the bit gives ELOOP (40)
how_identified.O_CLOEXEC: the only bit for which F_GETFD reports FD_CLOEXEC
how_identified.O_DIRECT: a directory opened with the bit gives EINVAL (22) on the card, the root filesystem and tmpfs

also_observed.directory_fsync: works on the card (fsync returns 0), so the counter slots' durability needed no change
also_observed.create_exclusive: O_CREAT with O_EXCL creates a new file and refuses an existing one with EEXIST (17)

run.power_cycle: none; the boot identity did not change
app_log_lines: APP ERROR storage open: storage IO failure
run.counter_slots: state/counter.0 and state/counter.1, 20 bytes each, advanced to 1

bulky_originals.note: the JPEG and DNG stay local at their ignored paths and on the camera's card; the DNG is 33,733,196 bytes

local_evidence_files.open-flags-probe.txt: the full probe output, every candidate bit on four paths
local_evidence_files.storage-open-strace.txt: the trace excerpt of the failing open
local_evidence_files.app-run.log: the app and capture library logs of the run

not_proven: the fresh-boot path (stock active, then stopped by the launcher) was not repeated; the run used the same-boot reentry path
only one shot was taken; the counter persisted to 1
